# Shutap

> Vent like it's your smartest friend. The easiest way to get it off your chest — type it, spill it, someone always replies. Your real name never shows.

Shutap is the alternative to anonymous-feed venting (Reddit, AITA, Quora). Members keep a consistent pseudonym across stories so voices have a track record, and outcomes are confirmed by the original author rather than inferred from sentiment.

The brand wordplay is "Shutap → speak up." The app is not a clinical service; the in-app companion never poses as a therapist or lawyer.

## Core

- [About](https://shutap.com/about): What Shutap is, who it's for, and how it differs from anonymous feed venting.
- [How it works](https://shutap.com/how-it-works): Real people, AI-guided, outcomes confirmed — plus how sensitive topics route to real help.
- [Lived Intelligence](https://shutap.com/lived-intelligence): The human counterpart to AI — the practical knowledge earned by living through real situations and seeing how they turn out.
- [Trust & privacy](https://shutap.com/trust): Pseudonymity model, PII scrubbing before storage, what is and isn't indexed, takedown path.

## Pillars

- [Relationships](https://shutap.com/relationships): Dating, partners, situationships, breakups, the gray area in between.
- [Marriage](https://shutap.com/marriage): The long-haul stuff — roommate energy, resentment, repair, leaving, staying.
- [Family](https://shutap.com/family): Parents, siblings, in-laws, the family group chat, the guilt.
- [Career](https://shutap.com/career): Work, money, bosses, burnout, the job everyone tells you to be grateful for.

## Legal & policies

- [FAQ](https://shutap.com/faq): Common questions — is it therapy (no), is it anonymous (pseudonymous), how is my data handled.
- [Terms of Service](https://shutap.com/terms): The rules of the room; 18+; not a medical or legal service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://shutap.com/privacy): Pseudonymous by design, PII scrubbed before storage, no sale of data, full access/export/delete rights.
- [Community Guidelines](https://shutap.com/guidelines): Protect privacy, aim any sharpness at situations not people.
- [Safety](https://shutap.com/safety): Crisis resources (988, Samaritans, findahelpline) and how the companion routes to real help.
- [AI Disclosure](https://shutap.com/ai-disclosure): What the AI does, what it isn't, that it can be wrong, and which models power the companion and Mirror.
- [Legal hub](https://shutap.com/legal): Index of all policy pages.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://shutap.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of indexable pages.
